business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Lightweight Ad-Monetized Mobile Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law with embedded Islamic commercial principles and Sharia influence for personal status matters)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (as amended) on Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism; Executive Regulations issued by the Central Bank of Oman under Circular BM 971 and CBO AML/CFT Guideline 2017; Beneficial ownership record-keeping obligations introduced under the Oman Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, and Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion Implementing Decision No. (10/2020) on the electronic register of beneficial owners.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public or competent government authority in the jurisdiction of nationality/residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization at the Sultanate of Oman Embassy/Consulate if one of the contracting party's documents is from a non-Apostille country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Corporate Abstract of the Foreign Corporate Sole Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home country trade registry or competent companies registrar

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly Notarised Power of Attorney appointing an Omani licensed local incorporation agent/registered auditor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home country notary or Omani notary public (if executed inside Oman)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised and legalised Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Ultimate Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Custody of the ultimate parent's formation authority / home country company registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced customer due diligence in accordance with FATF standards: before incorporation and at the filing of UBO information, all individuals and corporate entities are screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and 13X lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, HM Treasury Consolidated Sanctions List, and the Omani domestic sanctions circular issued by the Central Bank. PEPs (resident, foreign, and officials of international organisations) are classified as high risk and must be subject to senior-management-approved enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and continuous ongoing monitoring. Adherence to Financial Intelligence Unit of Oman (FIU-Oman) STR/SAR reporting protocols is mandatory.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy (Official Omani Business Portal) — investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Every commercial company in Oman must have a statutory Arabic name registered with the Commercial Registry. The Arabic name shall be composed of the company type, a proposed trade/short name, and may include a French or English transliteration as a trade name. The foreign transliteration must be a phonetic transcription of the Arabic name and shall not contain any word conflicting with Islamic morals, public order, or government entities. Arabic naming standards require the name to be distinct, truthful, and not misleading; Latin characters are permitted solely as an additional trade mark/trade-name filing under MCIIP Practice Direction.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Islamicate/Islamic (requires prior approval from Ministry of Awqaf and Religious Affairs)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal via the Invest Easy portal within 15 working days from the date of the refusal notice. The appeal must include the original name request, the basis of rejection, a supporting legal memorandum showing that the rejected name does not violate Articles 20–24 of the Executive Regulations of the Commercial Companies Law, and any revised consent from the relevant ministerial body. The Commercial Registration Appeals Committee shall render written decision within 20 working days. No filing fee is charged for an initial appeal; a market-practice legal drafting fee of USD 350 may be incurred for external counsel.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office address service is permissible for a low-risk software publisher branch/SPC subject to the following conditions: the virtual office provider must be a licensed company registration agent or accredited business-centre operator having a physical place of business in Oman; the contract must provide for service of process, mail forwarding, and official notification; and the authorities require that the registered address shown in the Commercial Register shall be the virtual office provider's physical street address, with an indication of the licensed agent as caretaker. The SPC must not carry out all business functions virtually; it must in all events maintain accessible commercial books and records in Oman, and the virtual arrangement must be disclosed in the UBO/CDD file.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate quantified risk: approximately 15% annual probability for a passive hyper-casual game publisher, rising to 30% upon any inconsistency, unusual transaction, or red flag revealed during business-bank account opening or intermediary payout screening. MCIIP, commercial inspectors, and AML authority have legal power to conduct unannounced physical inspection on the registered office to verify commercial substance, board involvement, and data access.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Oman Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019 as amended by Royal Decree No. 61/2021), Single Person Company chapter (Articles 262–273); Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019), Articles 2–4.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) – Commercial Registry Department, InvestEasy One-Stop Shop.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association of Single Person Company (SPC) and Commercial Registration (CR) application form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SPC; capital is fixed by the sole shareholder in the Memorandum of Association. No escrow bank account is required for a digital publishing activity; share capital may be contributed post-incorporation and evidenced by bank confirmation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The sole shareholder hereby subscribes to the entire issued share capital of the Single Person Company and adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association presented. FURTHER RESOLVED: The registered office is established at [registered address], Muscat Governorate, Sultanate of Oman, and the authorized officers are instructed to file all statutory incorporation documents with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion. FURTHER RESOLVED: [Name] is appointed General Manager and Company Secretary; [Name] is appointed Compliance Officer for tax, AML-CFT, and payment-rail obligations. All officers are individually authorized to execute, notarize, and submit incorporation filings, open corporate bank accounts, and operationalize the company's digital publishing business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIIP InvestEasy online portal (investeasy.gov.om) – Commercial Registry Department.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed Arabic company names with English transliterations through InvestEasy. The trade name must not conflict with existing marks, must not contain prohibited religious or sovereign terms, and must end with 'SPC' or its Arabic equivalent. Approval is issued electronically as a name reservation certificate, valid for sixty days.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the foreign sole shareholder
Proposed trade names in Arabic and English
Description of activity corresponding to ISIC 5820 software publishing
Valid e-mail address and Omani contact telephone number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused on grounds of duplication or objectionable wording, file a fresh reservation application with alternative names. An administrative reconsideration may also be lodged with MCIIP within thirty days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Omani lawyer and Notary Public, followed by MCIIP Commercial Registry authentication.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Omani counsel to draft the SPCA Memorandum and Articles compliant with Royal Decree No. 18/2019. The sole shareholder executes the document; signatures are notarized before an Omani notary. If the shareholder is a foreign entity, consular legalization or apostille of constitutional documents must be completed before filing.
required_dossiers: Drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association
Apostille or Omani consular legalization of shareholder corporate documents (if corporate shareholder)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial or MCIIP queries concerning capital clauses, activity scope, or shareholder capacity are cured by filing an amended notarized Memorandum of Association within fifteen working days, without loss of priority date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIIP Commercial Registry through the InvestEasy one-stop shop.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Memorandum, name reservation receipt, registered office lease, and identification pack via InvestEasy. Pay the Commercial Registration filing fee of approximately OMR 100 (USD 260). Upon approval, the Commercial Registration Certificate is issued reflecting the legal form SPC and activity ISIC 5820 software publishing.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Foreign investment approval under Royal Decree No. 50/2019, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the authorities query the capital amount or the descriptive activity wording, submit a supplementary shareholder declaration and an amended lease; the CR is corrected within ten working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), governorate branch.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the Commercial Registration card at the OCCI office in the governorate of the registered office within thirty days of issuance. Obtain the OCCI membership certificate, which is required for invoice attestation and certain banking formalities. Foreign-owned SPCs must provide shareholder identity and registered office proof.
required_dossiers: Passports and residence cards of shareholder and manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration may attract nominal late membership fees; cure by immediate online payment and submission of the CR, without substantive administrative penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Authority and Social Insurance Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) and Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register for corporate income tax with the OTA within three months of Commercial Registration using the CR certificate. Enroll as a VAT registrant under Royal Decree No. 121/2016 (5 percent VAT) if taxable supplies from AdMob and AppLovin payouts exceed OMR 38,500 per annum. Register as an employer with PASI upon first hire.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of shareholder and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA queries beneficial ownership, file a beneficial-ownership declaration and CDD pack; late registration is cured by payment of any nominal administrative fine and compliance with an installment arrangement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of the governorate (e.g., Muscat Municipality) and Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) under the Royal Oman Police.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the municipal commercial activity license for the physical registered office. This software publishing activity does not require an industrial or manufacturing license. CDAA assesses the office premises for fire safety, issuing a fire safety compliance certificate for the premises usable as an office. Submit the floor plan and fire safety self-declaration to the municipality.
required_dossiers: Floor plan and fire safety compliance form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal refusal due to zoning is cured by relocating the registered office to a compliant commercial zone. CDAA deficiency notifications are remedied by installing extinguishers, detectors, and exit signage, followed by re-inspection within thirty days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the MCIIP Industrial Development Department has no oversight of ISIC 5820 software publishing; no factory, manufacturing, or industrial establishment permit is triggered.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – the Commercial Registration certificate and municipal commercial activity license are the only operating authorizations required for a head-office digital publishing operation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category 3 – Office and digital IT services; no EIA report, registration, or screening form required for a purely office-based software publishing operation).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater, VOC, or industrial waste streams generated. If the leased office installs a standby diesel generator below 100 kVA, EA registration and compliance with diesel generator emission limits under the Unified Regulation on Hazardous Substances apply; office generators above 100 kVA require an EA permit. Standard municipal waste collection contracts apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: CDAA fire safety certificate for the registered office, covering fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, emergency exits, and evacuation routes; municipal occupational health clearance under applicable labor protection regulations for workplaces exceeding 10 employees or 500 square meters; structural load certification not required beyond standard commercial building code compliance for IT equipment rooms.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA; formerly the Secretariat General of Taxation) under the Ministry of Finance; single national-level tax administration with no sub-jurisdictional tax authorities; official electronic portal: https://tax.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Single Person Company (SPC) under the Omani Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019) and obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP); no minimum paid-up capital is required and 100% foreign ownership is permitted. Step 2: Register the SPC for income tax with the OTA via the tax.gov.om portal within three months of commencing business to obtain the Tax Identification Number (TIN); resident status is determined by incorporation and effective management in Oman. Step 3: Complete VAT registration on the same portal; registration is mandatory if annual taxable supplies and imports exceed OMR 500,000, and voluntary if they exceed OMR 38,000; a non-resident person making taxable supplies in Oman must register without a turnover threshold and must appoint a tax representative. Step 4: Maintain CR/TIN linkage, board resolutions, accounting records, bank account details, and statutory registrations (customs, social insurance, regulatory) prior to invoicing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the Omani SPC is a resident juridical person taxed separately from its sole foreign shareholder under the Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009 as amended); profits are taxed at the standard 15% corporate rate, with a reduced 3% rate on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income for qualifying small businesses (paid-up capital not exceeding OMR 50,000). The SPC is subject to entity-level taxation on worldwide business income; no pass-through, transparency, or consolidated group treatment exists, and there is no territorial ring-fencing for resident companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Omani domestic law; the SPC cannot elect pass-through treatment. Available elections include: (i) voluntary VAT registration under Article 13 of the VAT Law (Royal Decree 121/2020) where annual taxable supplies and imports exceed OMR 38,000 but remain below the OMR 500,000 mandatory threshold; (ii) election to adopt a non-calendar fiscal year subject to prior OTA approval, used consistently for CIT and VAT; (iii) discretionary instalment-payment facility for assessed corporate tax; and (iv) time-of-supply elections (invoice versus payment basis) permitted by the VAT Executive Regulations. No group relief, tax-transparent election, or hybrid-mismatch alignment mechanism is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) enacted by Royal Decree 121/2020 with Executive Regulations under Royal Decree 53/2021, as amended by Royal Decree 19/2023; administered by the Oman Tax Authority; no GST, sales tax, or municipal/city indirect taxes exist in the Sultanate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration where annual taxable supplies plus taxable imports exceed OMR 500,000 (VAT Law Article 13); voluntary registration where annual taxable supplies and imports exceed OMR 38,000; non-resident suppliers carrying on taxable activity in Oman must register without turnover threshold and appoint a tax representative; imported digital services supplied by non-residents to an Omani taxable person are subject to reverse charge at the 10% standard rate, with the SPC acting as the accounting party.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman does not currently operate a statutory real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, API-based e-invoicing, or digital-stamping regime comparable to Saudi ZATCA Phase 2 or Egyptian e-invoicing. The OTA has announced a phased roadmap toward mandatory e-invoicing, but as of this dossier's reference date the mandate is not yet in force. Taxpayers may issue machine-readable electronic tax invoices in XML/PDF with sequential unique numbers and VAT registration details under the VAT Executive Regulations and must retain all electronic records for at least ten years for OTA inspection. A transition and onboarding period will apply once the formal e-invoicing mandate is enacted.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: zero-rating applies where ownership and risk pass to a non-resident customer, the goods physically depart Oman within 90 days of supply, and contemporaneous documents evidence the export. Services: zero-rating applies to a supply made to a taxable person located outside Oman (e.g., Google Ireland Limited or AppLovin Ireland) where the place-of-supply rules situate the supply outside the Sultanate and the benefit is received outside Oman. The hyper-casual game publisher's ad-monetisation payouts received from AdMob and AppLovin qualify as exported advertising-inventory services (B2B supplies to non-resident ad-tech platforms) taxable at 0% VAT, preserving the SPC's entitlement to reclaim input VAT incurred on Omani server hosting, development, and distribution costs. The claim requires proof of the customer's foreign taxable-person status, a signed ad-network agreement, IP-geolocation evidence, and inward foreign-currency receipts.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Bayān) and export manifest validated by Oman Customs evidencing departure from Oman (for goods)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill with corresponding freight delivery and port/terminal export evidence
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign-currency bank credit advice from the SPC's Omani bank showing receipt of export proceeds from the non-resident customer

Commercial invoice, export contract, and, for zero-rated services: signed ad-network agreement (AdMob/AppLovin payout statements), non-resident VAT or legal-entity registration evidence, and service-performance/geolocation records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA reconciles zero-rating claims against customs Bayān data, bank foreign-currency receipts, and ad-tech payout reports; missing or inconsistent substantiation triggers recharacterisation of the supply as a domestic taxable supply at 10%, disallowance of input VAT credits, late-payment penalties, and administrative fines under the VAT Executive Regulations ranging from OMR 100 to OMR 100,000 per violation. In deliberate or fraudulent export schemes, the OTA may issue retrospective clawback assessments extending beyond the ordinary limitation period in cases of falsification, impose additional penalties of up to 100% of evaded VAT, and refer the matter to the Public Prosecution; the VAT Law provides for imprisonment of up to five years and/or fines of up to OMR 20,000, with personal liability attaching to the SPC's directors, managers, and signatories.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) - the sole authority responsible for monetary stability, banking supervision, and foreign exchange regulation in the Sultanate of Oman
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible for both current account and capital account transactions under the framework of Oman's acceptance of IMF Article VIII obligations. OMR is pegged to the US Dollar (USD) at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD, eliminating bilateral USD/OMR exchange-rate risk. Foreign-owned entities, including an Omani Single Person Company (SPC), may freely repatriate profits, dividends, and capital after meeting corporate tax filings and obtaining the required tax clearance certificate from the Oman Tax Authority. No general approval from the Central Bank is required for profit remittances, provided that transfers are executed through the local commercial banking system and valid supporting documents are retained.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export receipts under Omani law. Export proceeds, including advertising revenues from cross-border hyper-casual gaming services, may be credited to foreign-currency accounts at licensed Omani banks and held indefinitely in USD or any major currency. The CBO requires all export-related inflows to be declared to the bank for balance-of-payments statistical reporting (using CBO-governed purpose codes), but the proceeds are not required to be repatriated within a specific period nor converted into OMR. The SPC should promptly reconcile incoming AdMob and AppLovin payouts against invoice records in order to satisfy materiality and monitoring expectations of the receiving bank.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore digital electronic money institutions (EMIs). Oman has no separate EMI licensing regime under the Banking Law; non-bank payment service providers are not currently allowed to open virtual accounts or provide multi-currency IBAN-based shell accounts to Omani corporate entities. Using an unlicensed offshore EMI to sweep gaming revenues would create inbound wire risk, violate CBO capital and money-laundering regulations, and cause the receiving Omani bank to reject transactions. The SPC should route all treasury flows exclusively through licensed Omani banks or well-regulated cross-border correspondent banks supporting the Omani Rial.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence for at least one authorized director or senior manager is normally mandated during the corporate account opening process under the CBO's Anti-Money Laundering and Know-Your-Customer (AML/KYC) Regulations. Remote opening is not a standard available route for foreign-owned SPCs without a prior private banking relationship or special CBO dispensation. The original commercial registry certificate (CR), the Articles of Association, the tax registration certificate, and civil identification or passport copies of shareholders and signatories must be presented at the bank branch. An interview focusing on the source of funds and anticipated transaction flows will be conducted; remote video verification may be accepted only as a supplementary process but cannot replace the in-person meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign-owned SPC with a single shareholder who is not resident in Oman, presenting a high-risk beneficial-ownership profile due to unavailability of corporate references.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the original and certified translated CR, an apostilled power of attorney, a shareholder register showing the ultimate beneficial owner, a notarized board resolution appointing the authorised signatories, and two valid trade/bank references from reputable financial institutions. Also provide audited financial statements or a detailed business plan demonstrating the actual digital publishing activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Hyper-casual gaming revenue received via digital advertising networks (AdMob, AppLovin) with no clear underlying export documentation or physical invoice trail, exposing the bank to potential proceeds-of-crime concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a master service agreement with each advertising network, platform payout statements, monthly revenue reports, user analytics dashboards, and public app store listings confirming the mobile game live status. Include a clear org chart and a narrative on the value chain from ad clicks to fund settlement in the Omani bank account. Retain transaction-specific MT103 messages or payout confirmations for at least 5 years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected transaction volume from a mobile gaming app far exceeding the stated initial capital or projected revenue, raising a 'disproportionate activity' red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a granular 12-month cash-flow projection showing daily or weekly ad-network settlement cycles, a breakdown of CPI (cost-per-install) and ARPDAU (average revenue per daily active user) metrics, and historical traction in other jurisdictions. Confirm the SPC's economic substance in Oman, including the use of a local registered address, resident director (if any), and bookkeeping arrangements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of multiple jurisdictions, cloud-based services, and offshore IP-licensing vehicles, triggering heightened due diligence on source of wealth and legitimate business rationale.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the intragroup IP licensing agreement, registered trademark/patent proof, full corporate diagram with all related parties, and a transfer-pricing documentation summary demonstrating arm's-length remuneration. Clarify that the Omani SPC is the commercial operator receiving royalties and advertising revenue, while any offshore IP holding vehicle is exclusively for IP ownership with valid legal/economic substance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The initial capital contribution and any subsequent equity injections into the Omani SPC must be routed through an authorized Omani commercial bank using SWIFT MT103 or local real-time gross settlement (RTGS) if initiated within the GCC. Corporate remittances from abroad must include a proper purpose code under the CBO's Balance of Payments classification; for equity capital this is typically 'Equity capital other than retained earnings' (purpose code 1000) for FDI entry, and the receiving bank will require a copy of the CR, the board resolution authorizing the capital contribution, and proof of the investor's banking provenance. The Omani bank will issue a Foreign Investment Report or E-form entry for central bank statistics. If the injection exceeds OMR 10,000 (approx. USD 26,000), enhanced due diligence may apply, requiring bank statements, source-of-funds evidence for the remitter, and confirmation that the amount aligns with the stated paid-up capital level.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for international trade or services are executed through the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) network using MT103 single payment messages, or MT202 for bank-to-bank transfers. For cross-border service disbursements (e.g., licensing fees, software subscriptions, cloud infrastructure storage, affiliate commissions), the standard rail is a SWIFT MT103 with an application header identifying the beneficiary bank plus the CBO-coded purpose (e.g., 'Data processing and hosting services' or 'Royalties and license fees'). Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) are generally not required for intangible digital gaming transactions, but an LC may be used for physical marketing materials, hardware purchases, or co-publishing agreements; for LCs, only irrevocable, confirmed documentary credits conforming to UCP600 are accepted. The Omani SPC must retain invoices, service contracts, and evidence of import/export delivery to justify each outward payment from its operational account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward Contracts (USD/OMR and OMR/USD) up to 12 months, offered by Omani banks against a demonstrable underlying commercial exposure; no margin or collateral required if covered by revenue receivables
FX Currency Swaps (OMR/USD) between licensed Omani banks and the SPC, used to convert periodic USD advertising inflows into OMR liquidity while retaining a USD balance
No Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) have market or regulatory viability in Oman due to the fixed peg of the OMR to the USD, which renders NDFs redundant and non-standard

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial register annual renewal certificate (renewal of the commercial license and CR file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registry / Oman Business Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the exact expiry date shown on the Commercial Registration certificate; renewal is accepted in the final 30 days before expiry, and continued operation after expiry is not permitted.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a default fine and automatic suspension of the commercial license; if renewal remains outstanding, MoCIIP may administratively strike off the SPC and initiate dissolution under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax annual return (income tax declaration) with audited or signed financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the financial year; for a calendar-year entity, the filing deadline is no later than 30 April of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of OMR 100 per month of delay up to OMR 1,000, plus late-payment penalties on any assessed tax; persistent non-filing allows OTA to make a substitute assessment and block tax clearance needed for commercial renewals and bank operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation / UBO register update confirmation for the single shareholder
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Beneficial Ownership e-register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed with the annual commercial registration renewal (anniversary date); any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must also be recorded and filed within the prescribed short statutory period of 14 to 30 days from the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file an accurate UBO confirmation is an AML/CFT regulatory offence; fines can reach OMR 50,000 under the AML Law, and MoCIIP will condition any subsequent license renewal on a current UBO on file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory audited annual financial statements and audit report prepared under Oman Commercial Companies Law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Independent licensed auditor, the single member, and Oman Tax Authority where the financial statements accompany the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be signed and available before the annual tax return deadline (four months after year-end); if the articles require shareholder approval, presentation to the single member must occur within six months of the financial year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint a licensed auditor or to produce audited financial statements is an offence under the Commercial Companies Law; it may lead to monetary fines, director/manager personal liability, rejection of the tax return, and adverse impact on the commercial registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No turnover or capital threshold: every Omani SPC must appoint an independent auditor licensed in Oman and have its annual accounts audited under the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019). For tax filing purposes, audited financial statements are ordinarily required; OTA may, at its discretion, accept unaudited statements only in no-income or below-threshold cases, but the companies-law audit obligation remains mandatory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB, presented in Arabic or bilingual Arabic/English; no separate local GAAP applies to commercial companies in Oman.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For an SPC, the single shareholder must be recorded in the Register of Members. As part of the annual commercial registration maintenance, the SPC must submit an annual no-change or update confirmation of the ultimate beneficial owner to the MoCIIP electronic UBO register. Any transfer of the single share requires simultaneous updating of the Register of Members and the MoCIIP UBO record; until the revised UBO filing is made, the transfer may not be fully effective against third parties for administrative/regulatory purposes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (single shareholder and transfers)
Statutory Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO Register)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 to 2,000 per annum in Muscat for a registered office and local corporate agent; USD 1,500 to 3,500 if the agent provides full annual compliance, license renewal, and UBO filing administration.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,000 to 3,000 for an IFRS audit of a simple SPC with low transaction volume; USD 3,000 to 6,000 where hyper-casual game revenue, foreign subsidiaries, or intercompany payouts require additional audit procedures and transfer pricing documentation.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% on taxable income exceeding OMR 100,000; 3% on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income (Royal Decree 25/2023, effective for tax years beginning on or after 1 January 2024)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No industry-specific tax holiday for hyper-casual gaming publishers; the 3% preferential band on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income is the primary statutory relief; deductions allowed for substantiated operating expenses (user acquisition, platform commissions, hosting, salaries); no group relief; no notional interest deduction

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form CIT-01) filed electronically via the Oman Tax Authority (OTA) e-portal at taxoman.om
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year (financial year-end); a single extension of up to 3 months may be granted by OTA upon justified request; tax instalments are due on a provisional basis where prior-year tax exceeded OMR 5,000

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial Registration (CR) number of the SPC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the CR number issued by the Omani Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion for the foreign-owned SPC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number (TIN) issued by OTA
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory; obtain TIN via OTA e-registration before filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax year period (start and end dates)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the SPC's audited financial year; must not exceed 12 months without OTA approval

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from game publishing (ad-monetization, in-app purchases, platform settlements from AdMob/AppLovin)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross proceeds net of refunds and platform commissions but before deduction of user-acquisition costs; foreign-source mobile game revenue is taxable in Oman if attributable to the SPC's management and economic activity in Oman

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales: server hosting, app store commissions, payment gateway fees, SDK licensing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only costs with proper invoices/contracts and economic nexus to the Oman SPC are deductible

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses: salaries, marketing/user acquisition, legal, rent, accounting, software subscriptions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners' charges must satisfy the arm's-length standard and be supported by transfer pricing documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible items (provisions, penalties, entertainment 50%, non-business gifts)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include any head-office or shareholder general-management fees not supported by actual services

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit before tax (reconciled with audited financial statements)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach audited Omani GAAP/IFRS financial statements for foreign-owned SPC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses brought forward utilised (maximum 5 years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses available only if the SPC filed timely returns and retained OTA-approved loss schedules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss relief
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If taxable income ≤ OMR 100,000, apply 3% band; if > OMR 100,000, apply 3% on the first bracket and 15% on the excess

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax at 3% on the first OMR 100,000 (maximum OMR 3,000)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned SPC, including wholly foreign-owned shareholders, receives the same bracket; no discrimination under QAR

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax at 15% on taxable income exceeding OMR 100,000
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Calculate precisely; rounding to nearest OMR rial

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits (if any) on double-taxed income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only available under a DTA or unilateral credit provision; capped at Omani tax attributable to the foreign income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated tax instalments previously paid
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offset instalments paid under quarterly estimated payment regime

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of tax due or refund claimed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay any balance electronically via OTA portal at the time of filing to stop late-payment surcharges

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction disclosure and transfer pricing summary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare cross-border related-party transactions (IP licence fees, management fees, intercompany loans) and attach TP documentation if revenue threshold met

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 2% of the tax due for each commenced month of delay, up to a maximum of 25% of the tax due, plus a fixed administrative fine of OMR 1,000 when no tax is due; late payment penalty: 1.5% monthly surcharge on the unsettled tax amount, capped at 30% of the tax liability; failure to file for more than 12 months triggers audit and potential criminal referral for tax evasion

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Withholding Tax Return (Form WHT-02) filed electronically via OTA e-portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 days after the end of each calendar month in which non-resident payments subject to withholding are made

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calendar month of the withholding event
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in the month payment is booked in the SPC's accounts, regardless of actual money transfer date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross royalties paid to non-resident IP licensors (game engine SDKs, proprietary code licences)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 10% statutory WHT applies to royalties; reduced treaty rate claimable only upon OTA-approved TRC submission

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross fees for technical or consultancy services rendered physically or remotely to the Oman SPC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Service fees attributable to services performed in Oman attract 10% WHT; offshore back-office services may be exempt if no Oman-source nexus

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: WHT liability calculated at 10% (or reduced treaty rate)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withhold and remit in OMR within the statutory deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) reference for treaty-reduced rates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach apostilled TRC and beneficial-ownership declaration; absent these, apply statutory 10%

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file WHT-02: OMR 250 per month of delay, capped at OMR 2,500; failure to withhold or remit: 100% recovery of the unpaid WHT plus a monthly surcharge of 2% up to 30% of the amount recoverable; non-remittance of third-party tax is a criminal offence exposing directors to personal liability

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Estimated Tax Payment Schedule (Form CIT-05) filed electronically via OTA e-portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Four equal quarterly instalments due on 15th day of months 3, 6, 9 and 12 of the tax year, where the prior year's final tax exceeded OMR 5,000

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax year for which estimates are computed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Estimate current-year taxable income using prior-year audited results and projected AdMob/AppLovin flows

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior year final tax assessed
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Used as the baseline for instalment computation if estimates are impracticable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated current-year tax at 3%/15% bands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Re-estimate quarterly and adjust instalments if revenue materially deviates

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly instalment amount (25% of estimated tax)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay by the enforcement date; underpayment triggers OTA interest of 1% monthly on the shortfall

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Underpayment of estimated instalments: monthly 1% interest on the underpaid balance until satisfied; non-filing of the estimate schedule: OMR 500 fixed fine plus loss of any abatement of interest

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Oman levies no dividend withholding tax on profit distributions by a resident SPC to a non-resident shareholder; dividends are not treated as taxable Omani-source income and are fully free of Omani WHT)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where a non-resident shareholder or licensor seeks a reduced rate on royalties/interests/services, the Oman SPC must: (1) obtain from the foreign payee an apostilled/legalised Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) proving residence in the DTA jurisdiction and beneficial ownership; (2) submit the TRC together with an OTA treaty-relief application (Form TR-1) before or at the time of the payment; (3) obtain OTA written approval to apply the reduced rate at source; (4) if relief is denied, pay the statutory 10% WHT and file a reclaim within 5 years supported by the TRC and full payment evidence; (5) include the relief claim and no-objection letter in the annual CIT-01 filing package
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP licences (game engines, trademarks, software copyrights) paid to non-residents: statutory WHT 10%, treaty-reduced to 0–10% depending on DTA (e.g., France 10%, UK 0% for copyright royalties, India 10%, UAE 0% where applicable); interest on foreign shareholder loans: no statutory Omani WHT on arm's-length interest, but interest economically equivalent to profit distribution or paid under excessive debt may be recharacterised as a dividend or disallowed; if recharacterised, 10% WHT applies and treaty benefits are revoked for non-beneficial owners

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File are mandatory where annual gross revenue exceeds OMR 10,000,000 (approx. USD 26,000,000) and cross-border related-party transactions exist; Country-by-Country Report notification applies to a multinational group with consolidated group revenue equal to or exceeding OMR 375,000,000 (approx. USD 975,000,000); contemporaneous documentation must be prepared by the tax filing deadline and produced to OTA within 30 days of request
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has no standalone annual Economic Substance Regulation filing (unlike UAE), but Royal Decree 25/2023 contains a general anti-avoidance rule and substance-based recharacterisation power: arrangements lacking commercial rationality or real economic substance (employees, offices, board decisions, administrative and strategic functions in Oman) may be disregarded by OTA. The SPC must evidence central management and control in Oman, active participation in game publishing decisions, local staff, and substantive procurement of AdMob/AppLovin monetisation services; a mere letterbox SPC holding foreign IP licences and channelling ad revenue into offshore accounts will be deemed a sham and all income will be reattributed to the SPC, erasing treaty benefits and foreign tax credits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion (Royal Decree 25/2023, Article 105 and Exec. Regs)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate submission of false hyper-casual game revenue figures, omission of AdMob/AppLovin settlement statements, inflating user-acquisition deductions with fake invoices, or destroying accounting records to reduce taxable income below OMR 100,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to 200% of the evaded tax plus OMR 5,000–OMR 100,000 administrative penalty; criminal referral to the Omani public prosecutor with imprisonment up to 5 years; the SPC's CR licence may be suspended or revoked; audit and confiscation of proceeds from all connected bank accounts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the single foreign shareholder who signed or knowingly caused false returns are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, civil restitution, and criminal fines; OTA may issue a travel ban and freeze personal bank accounts in Oman; imprisonment up to 5 years applies to individuals; the corporate veil is pierced where the SPC is proven to be a mere façade for the shareholder's personal tax avoidance

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an SPC with no physical office, zero employees, no board meetings in Oman, and using the Oman entity solely to book AdMob/AppLovin ad revenue while IP, decision-making and profits are shifted to an offshore affiliate in a zero-tax jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: OTA disregards the interposed entity and reattributes all income to the SPC; additional tax at 15% plus a 50% deliberate-negligence penalty; denial of treaty relief and foreign tax credits; cancellation of the SPC's commercial registration; blacklisting of the foreign shareholder from Omani business activities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for the entire unpaid corporate tax where the SPC is treated as the shareholder's alter ego; directors face civil restitution claims, confiscation of personal assets used in the operation, travel bans, and, under the Omani Commercial Companies Law, imprisonment for fraud where the corporate form is used to evade public obligations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Cross-border related-party transactions (IP royalty payments, intercompany service fees, loans from the foreign parent) above the OMR 10,000,000 revenue threshold without prepared Local File/Master File, or the application of a non-arm's-length margin on hyper-casual game publishing functions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: OTA imposes a TP adjustment on deemed arm's-length income; additional tax plus a penalty of up to 30% of the adjusted tax differential; fixed fine up to OMR 5,000 for missing documentation; monthly default interest of 1.5% on the additional assessment until paid
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign TP declarations knowing documentation is absent or false are personally fined up to OMR 10,000; where an incorrect TP position strips profit from the Omani taxing base, OTA may pierce the veil and hold the foreign parent liable for the SPC's tax debts as a de facto shadow director; travel restrictions apply during investigations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Payment Rail Misuse (Royal Decree 30/2016 AML Law and Central Bank of Oman enforcement)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling AdMob/AppLovin payouts through unregistered personal accounts, misrepresenting the economic purpose of payments to payment service providers, executing repetitive structured transfers to offshore entities without commercial rationale, or accepting ad revenue attributable to unlawful gambling content
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Financial penalty up to OMR 250,000 per AML violation and up to double the illicit transaction value; freezing of all payment accounts; suspension of banking relationships in Oman; criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to 7 years for money laundering; revocation of the SPC's commercial licence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The single director and beneficial owner face personal criminal liability, seizure of personal and corporate bank balances, travel bans, and imprisonment; failure to appoint an AML compliance officer (where required) constitutes director negligence; civil liability extends to the full amount laundered plus legal costs; OTA and the Central Bank of Oman coordinate asset-forfeiture actions against nominee shareholders
